dateEvidence: Two searches: the safety public assessment reports page is said to list the PAR as added 27 July 2026, and a second summary states 'Published: 27 July 2026'. The date is not printed in any excerpt of the publication page or PDF itself, so it is read second-hand through search summaries. The page used as source is the publication page https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/bladder-anticholinergics-review-of-risk-of-dementia (a publication, not a news item). 'older people / limit number / lowest dose' advice IS stated, but the search attributes it to the MHRA Safety Roundup July 2026 (30 July per first pass), not necessarily the report.
notes: Advice sentences (c05, c10) are attributed in retrieval to the July 2026 Safety Roundup; add that URL to references or confirm in the PAR. 'lowest dose' appears in source as 'lowest dose to control their condition'; it is clinician advice, not a dose or cut-off. No 'safe' wording, no individual instructions. Two textbook sentences out of 12 exceeds the 1-in-20 rule; c12 is only a site cross-link and may be left out of the claims count. Brief may stay if the roundup is cited; no reason to drop.
